title: SolarEdge presents MVAC-to-800 VDC development hardware at OCP 2026
publisher: SolarEdge investor-relations newsroom via Business Wire
specific_claims: SolarEdge announced an MVAC-to-800 VDC AI Factory Power Technology showcase at the 2026 OCP Global Summit.
The showcase included an SST cell and a 3D-printed model of a containerized data-center power architecture.
SolarEdge attributed under-load operation to a conversion stage in its engineering labs.
SolarEdge said system-level validation of the complete power path was underway.
supports: An attributable October 2026 technology-showcase event occurred.
SolarEdge publicly described an MVAC-to-800 VDC development architecture and engineering-lab work.
does_not_support: A named data-center field deployment or commercial operation.
Independent performance, safety or reliability validation.
Completed full-path system validation, repeat procurement, replication or industry adoption.
conflicts_counter_evidence: The displayed containerized architecture was a 3D-printed model.
The release says full-path system validation remained underway.
The release contains forward-looking limitations covering validation, reliability, availability and adoption.
search_boundary: SolarEdge official HTML release, its official two-page PDF rendering, and the explicitly linked Business Wire distribution copy; no independent performance dataset or named deployment record was reviewed.
x_candidate_text: SolarEdge’s Oct. 13 update: an SST cell and 3D model for MVAC-to-800 VDC AI power were showcased at OCP. Full-path validation remains underway; this is not a named field deployment. Evidence update: https://structurevidence.org/cases/800vdc/events/solaredge-ocp-2026/
